# Comic book

Bold outlines and confident emphasis with a playful editorial voice.

## Use

Use for campaign explainers, memorable tips, and short learning challenges.

## Essential traits

- Bold dark outlines
- Limited primary palette
- Halftone outside text

## Typography

Heavy system sans-serif headings with readable body text.

## Layout and surfaces

Strong outlined blocks, occasional angular accents, clear reading order. Halftone accents and offset black shadows.

## Palette

- background: #ffdc67
- surface: #fff9e5
- text: #252520
- muted: #59563d
- accent: #94332b
- border: #766e4c

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Comic book to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Heavy system sans-serif headings with readable body text. Strong outlined blocks, occasional angular accents, clear reading order. Halftone accents and offset black shadows. Palette: background #ffdc67, surface #fff9e5, text #252520, muted #59563d, accent #94332b, border #766e4c. Essential traits: Bold dark outlines; Limited primary palette; Halftone outside text. Avoid: All-caps body copy; Cluttered speech bubbles; Effects overpowering instructional content. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
